card.name: Opening parenthesis after FD&C Yellow No. 5
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after "FD&C Yellow No. 5", just before the name tartrazine, in color-additive warnings. It also fires weakly on nearby spots in the same phrase, such as "and" before "No. 6".

modes.description: The "(" that follows "FD&C Yellow No. 5" and introduces the name tartrazine.
